e.title: CAT Bond Pricing (MATLAB)
e.summary: 巨灾债券定价论文代码（UNSW）：体制切换物理/经济环境下的条件仿射定价公式
e.body: CAT Bond Pricing 是论文《Pricing catastrophe risk during transitions of physical and economic environments》的 MATLAB 代码（UNSW，Yuhao Howard Liu）：在体制切换（regime-switching）的物理与经济环境下定价巨灾债券现金流成分——用条件仿射公式 + 环境马尔可夫链模拟。ILS（保险连接证券）定价的前沿研究实现。与 [[eltr]]（巨灾 ELT 模拟）、[[tailloss]]（聚合尾部）、[[spatialextremes]]（空间极值）构成巨灾风险工具链。关联 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：UNSW 论文代码（体制切换环境 CAT 债券定价，条件仿射公式+马尔可夫链模拟），MATLAB
e.summary_en: Paper code for CAT-bond pricing (UNSW): conditional affine pricing under regime-switching physical and economic environments
e.summary_hk: 巨災債券定價論文代碼（UNSW）：體制切換物理/經濟環境下的條件仿射定價公式
e.body_en: CAT Bond Pricing is the MATLAB code of the paper 'Pricing catastrophe risk during transitions of physical and economic environments' (UNSW, Yuhao Howard Liu): pricing CAT-bond cash-flow components under regime-switching physical and economic environments — conditional affine formulas combined with Markov-chain environment simulation. A frontier research implementation for ILS (insurance-linked securities) pricing. With [[eltr]] (cat ELT simulation), [[tailloss]] (aggregate tails) and [[spatialextremes]] (spatial extremes) it forms the catastrophe-risk toolchain. Related: [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: CAT Bond Pricing 是論文《Pricing catastrophe risk during transitions of physical and economic environments》的 MATLAB 代碼（UNSW，Yuhao Howard Liu）：在體制切換（regime-switching）的物理與經濟環境下定價巨災債券現金流成分——用條件仿射公式 + 環境馬爾可夫鏈模擬。ILS（保險連接證券）定價的前沿研究實現。與 [[eltr]]（巨災 ELT 模擬）、[[tailloss]]（聚合尾部）、[[spatialextremes]]（空間極值）構成巨災風險工具鏈。關聯 [[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
